verdict.rationale: Fellow documents capturing in-person meetings, transcribing them, and making every conversation searchable through a full transcript in the workspace. However, that in-person capture is described only as audio captured directly from the desktop, and no mobile app is evidenced. missing for 10: a documented mobile app for recording in-person conversations, evidence that mobile-captured notes sync into the same searchable workspace, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
